_meta.description: S4 inference proposals — HYPOTHESES, sourcing-gated. NEVER auto-promoted; review + source + promote by hand.

sibc.entity: Advances against Fixed Deposits (Including FCNR (B), NRNR Deposits etc.)
Advances to Individuals against share, bonds, etc.
Weaker Sections including net PSLC- SF/MF

proposals.label: Large corporate deleveraging reversal → large corporate credit growth
proposals.mechanism: End of balance-sheet repair cycle drives large corporates to resume borrowing for capex and working capital expansion
proposals.required_source: RBI Financial Stability Report section on corporate leverage ratios and credit growth by firm size

proposals.label: Housing price cycle → housing loan demand
proposals.mechanism: Rising residential property prices in tier-1 and tier-2 cities increase transaction values and loan ticket sizes
proposals.required_source: NHB RESIDEX or RBI residential property price index quarterly series

proposals.label: Equity market wealth effect → securities-backed lending
proposals.mechanism: Bull market increases portfolio values enabling larger loans against shares and bonds as collateral
proposals.required_source: NSE/BSE market capitalization series and SEBI data on demat account holdings

proposals.label: Vehicle GST rate reduction → vehicle loan origination
proposals.mechanism: Lower GST on automobiles reduces on-road prices making vehicles more affordable and stimulating loan demand
proposals.required_source: GST Council meeting minutes and notifications on vehicle tax rate changes

proposals.label: Farm income support scheme → agricultural credit demand
proposals.mechanism: Direct benefit transfers under PM-KISAN improve farm cash flows reducing distress borrowing while enabling investment credit
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Agriculture PM-KISAN disbursement data and NABARD rural credit survey

proposals.label: Education fee inflation → education loan ticket size
proposals.mechanism: Rising higher education costs especially in private institutions and abroad increase per-student loan amounts
proposals.required_source: MHRD/UGC annual survey on college fee structures or forex remittances for education

proposals.label: Renewable energy PLI scheme → renewable project finance
proposals.mechanism: Production-linked incentives for solar manufacturing improve project economics driving solar installation credit
proposals.required_source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy PLI scheme notification and MNRE solar capacity addition data

proposals.label: PMAY subsidy extension → affordable housing credit
proposals.mechanism: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana interest subsidy continuation sustains demand for priority sector housing loans
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs PMAY scheme guidelines and CLSS disbursement reports

proposals.label: Social infrastructure asset classification → reporting reclassification
proposals.mechanism: RBI clarification on infrastructure lending classification brings health and education projects under social infrastructure reporting
proposals.required_source: RBI Master Direction on Infrastructure Lending and DBOD circulars on asset classification

proposals.label: Jan Dhan account maturity → weaker section credit access
proposals.mechanism: Aging of PMJDY accounts creates credit history enabling first-time formal credit to previously unbanked weaker sections
proposals.required_source: PMJDY progress reports from Department of Financial Services and RBI CRILC data on new-to-credit borrowers

proposals.label: ECLGS eligibility expansion → MSME credit surge
proposals.mechanism: Extension and expansion of Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme coverage and tenor encourages banks to lend to MSMEs
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Finance ECLGS notifications and National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company disbursement data

proposals.label: Personal loan competition intensity → other personal loan growth
proposals.mechanism: Fintech partnerships and digital origination reduce customer acquisition costs driving aggressive unsecured personal loan growth
proposals.required_source: RBI Report on Trend and Progress of Banking or Financial Stability Report section on unsecured retail credit growth

proposals.label: ATM interchange fee revision → off-site ATM economics
proposals.mechanism: Reduced interchange revenue makes off-site ATM deployment less profitable for independent deployers relative to on-site bank branches
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on ATM interchange fee structure or NPCI ATM interchange revision notification

proposals.label: Micro ATM subsidy expiry → deployment slowdown
proposals.mechanism: Government financial inclusion subsidy programs for micro ATM deployment expired causing reduced new installations and maintenance
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Finance or PMJDY subsidy scheme notifications for micro ATM deployment

proposals.label: UPI QR dominance → Bharat QR obsolescence
proposals.mechanism: UPI QR codes offering simpler integration and zero MDR made Bharat QR redundant for merchant acceptance
proposals.required_source: NPCI transaction statistics comparing UPI QR vs Bharat QR adoption trends

proposals.label: Credit card cash advance fee increase → ATM withdrawal economics
proposals.mechanism: Higher cash advance fees or revised MDR structure changed consumer economics of credit card ATM usage
proposals.required_source: RBI Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card operations or card network fee schedules

proposals.label: E-commerce GST compliance → digital payment routing
proposals.mechanism: Stricter GST compliance and invoice-matching requirements pushed e-commerce platforms toward credit card acceptance over debit
proposals.required_source: CBIC circulars on e-commerce GST compliance or payment reconciliation requirements

proposals.label: Tokenisation mandate → debit e-commerce friction
proposals.mechanism: RBI card tokenisation requirements created temporary friction in debit card e-commerce checkout flows
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on card tokenisation (RBI/2021-22/24) implementation timeline and compliance data

proposals.label: POS device migration mandate → deployment pause
proposals.mechanism: EMV chip-and-PIN or contactless upgrade mandates caused merchants to pause POS deployment during transition
proposals.required_source: RBI or NPCI circular on POS terminal certification or EMV migration deadlines

proposals.label: WhatsApp payment launch → DC other-channel growth
proposals.mechanism: WhatsApp Pay integration created new debit card usage channel classified under 'other' category
proposals.required_source: NPCI WhatsApp Pay authorization letter and monthly UPI participant transaction data

proposals.label: Credit-on-UPI launch → CC POS volume shift
proposals.mechanism: RuPay credit card linking to UPI enabled credit payments at POS terminals with QR codes
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on credit line on UPI (June 2023) and NPCI RuPay credit-on-UPI statistics

proposals.label: Fuel surcharge waiver removal → CC other-channel decline
proposals.mechanism: Removal of credit card fuel surcharge waivers shifted fuel payments away from 'other' channels
proposals.required_source: Card network communications on fuel surcharge policy changes or petroleum ministry notifications

proposals.label: ATM cash withdrawal limit revision → on-site preference
proposals.mechanism: Increased daily withdrawal limits made bank on-site ATMs more attractive for large withdrawals than off-site with lower limits
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on ATM cash withdrawal limits per transaction or per day

proposals.label: Business correspondent regulation tightening → micro ATM decline
proposals.mechanism: Stricter KYC and audit requirements for business correspondents increased compliance costs for micro ATM operation
proposals.required_source: RBI Master Direction on Business Correspondents or amendments to BC regulatory framework

proposals.label: Credit-card revolving-fee cap → outstanding stock
proposals.mechanism: RBI caps on late fees or penal charges reduce net revolving profitability and cause issuers to tighten credit lines or close inactive high-risk accounts, compressing reported outstanding balances
proposals.required_source: RBI Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions 2022 or subsequent amendments on penal/late fee caps

proposals.label: Co-branded card RBI guideline → card issuance strategy
proposals.mechanism: RBI clarifications on co-branding arrangements or data-sharing norms for fintech partnerships alter issuer distribution economics and slow premium co-branded card issuance
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on Credit Card Operations or co-branding/fintech partnership guidelines issued 2022–2024

proposals.label: Unsecured-loan risk-weight increase → credit-card line compression
proposals.mechanism: Higher risk weights on unsecured consumer credit raise capital cost per rupee of credit-card exposure, prompting issuers to cut unutilised limits and reduce outstanding balances
proposals.required_source: RBI notification on Risk Weights for Consumer Credit Exposure, November 2023 or later amendments

proposals.label: UPI credit-line-on-UPI → spend channel substitution
proposals.mechanism: NPCI launch of credit lines on UPI allows cardholders to route spend through UPI apps instead of physical/virtual card rails, depressing recorded card transaction volumes
proposals.required_source: NPCI press release or circular on UPI credit feature rollout and monthly UPI transaction statistics from NPCI

proposals.label: Festival-season spend surge → Q3 POS/e-commerce spike
proposals.mechanism: Diwali and year-end shopping festivals concentrate credit-card spending in October–December, creating predictable quarterly peaks in ATM withdrawal, POS, and e-commerce transaction values
proposals.required_source: RBI Database on Indian Economy (DBIE) Table 41: Credit Card Transactions monthly data or NPCI quarterly transaction reports

proposals.label: GST-input-credit digitisation → commercial-card B2B spend
proposals.mechanism: Businesses shift procurement to credit cards to streamline GST input-tax-credit reconciliation via digital trails, raising commercial-card POS and other transaction values
proposals.required_source: GSTN monthly e-way bill or e-invoice statistics and industry surveys on payment-method adoption for B2B transactions

proposals.label: Merchant-discount-rate negotiation → POS vs e-commerce mix
proposals.mechanism: Card networks and issuers adjust MDR splits, making e-commerce transactions relatively cheaper for merchants and shifting acceptance incentives away from physical POS
proposals.required_source: RBI Report on Trend and Progress of Banking or NPCI/card-network published MDR schedules and merchant-acceptance surveys

proposals.label: Foreign-transaction markup transparency rule → cross-border spend behavior
proposals.mechanism: RBI mandates upfront disclosure of forex markup on international card transactions, causing cardholders to reduce foreign ATM withdrawals and shift to lower-cost channels
proposals.required_source: RBI Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card or consumer-protection circular on forex-markup disclosure effective date

proposals.label: Tokenisation mandate → e-commerce transaction friction
proposals.mechanism: RBI card-tokenisation requirements for online merchants add authentication steps, temporarily depressing e-commerce transaction volumes until merchant compliance stabilises
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on Card-on-File Tokenisation dated September 2021 and subsequent deadline extensions, cross-checked with monthly e-commerce transaction data

proposals.label: Buy-now-pay-later regulation → short-tenor unsecured substitution
proposals.mechanism: RBI classification of BNPL as loans or tightening of digital-lending norms causes migration between BNPL and credit-card revolving balances, shifting outstanding stock
proposals.required_source: RBI guidelines on Digital Lending and BNPL dated 2022–2023 or updates to Master Direction on Non-Banking Financial Company regulations

proposals.label: Crude-oil price → transport-fuel card spend
proposals.mechanism: Petrol and diesel price movements directly drive credit-card POS transaction value at fuel stations, which form a material share of overall POS spend
proposals.required_source: Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell daily retail fuel price series and RBI monthly card-spend breakdowns by merchant category

proposals.label: Equity-market index → discretionary card spend
proposals.mechanism: Wealth effects from equity-market gains increase high-net-worth discretionary spending on travel, dining, and retail, lifting credit-card transaction values
proposals.required_source: NSE Nifty 50 or BSE Sensex monthly closing levels and household-finance surveys or card-issuer portfolio segmentation data
